description: This file contains utility functions related to Kubernetes storage classes, access modes, and persistent volume claims, including constants for annotations and functions to interpret storage class annotations and access modes.

methods.name: IsDefaultAnnotationText
methods.description: Returns 'Yes' if the object has a default storage class annotation set to 'true', otherwise 'No'.

methods.name: GetAccessModesAsString
methods.description: Converts a list of PersistentVolumeAccessMode to a comma-separated string with specific order and labels.

methods.name: removeDuplicateAccessModes
methods.description: Removes duplicate access modes from a list.

methods.name: ContainsAccessMode
methods.description: Checks if a specific access mode is present in a list.

methods.name: GetPersistentVolumeClass
methods.description: Returns the storage class name of a PersistentVolume, preferring beta annotation if present.

methods.name: GetPersistentVolumeClaimClass
methods.description: Returns the storage class name of a PersistentVolumeClaim, preferring beta annotation if present.
